days.title: Joy Comes with Morning
days.scriptureExcerpt: Weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.
days.encouragement: Tears tell the truth about the night. Morning tells another truth: sorrow does not get the last word.
days.prayer: God of morning, meet me after the long night. Let hope rise gently, honestly, and strong. Amen.
days.affirmation: Joy is still on its way.
days.scene: A vast wildflower meadow just after dawn rain, thousands of small blooms jeweled with drops while the sun breaks through. An adult Black woman in a flowing lavender skirt turns lightly in the lower-left, not posed, lifting her face to warm light. A fading rain curtain remains over distant hills. Preserve luminous sky on the upper-right.
days.scriptureFull: For his anger endureth but* a moment; in his favour is* life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh* in the morning.

days.title: God Is Working It Together
days.scriptureExcerpt: All things work together for good to them that love God
days.encouragement: Some pieces still look sharp and unrelated. Trust the hands that can place even broken colors into a larger beauty.
days.prayer: Father, hold the pieces I cannot reconcile. Work through loss, delay, and surprise without wasting any part of my story. Amen.
days.affirmation: The whole picture is still forming.
days.scene: Dark-skinned adult artisan hands arrange irregular pieces of translucent colored glass into a luminous mosaic pathway. Some pieces are cracked but edged with gold; together they form a sunrise and a winding road. Rich fabric, small tools, and reflected window light create tactile detail. Preserve a clean warm worktable and soft wall on the upper-left.
days.scriptureFull: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his* purpose.

days.title: Something New Is Springing
days.scriptureExcerpt: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth
days.encouragement: New life rarely asks permission from the old landscape. Watch for the small green evidence that God is already moving.
days.prayer: Lord, sharpen my eyes for beginnings. Give me courage to welcome the new path You are opening. Amen.
days.scene: A sweeping desert valley after rare rain, a new river ribboning through copper sand while fresh green shoots and tiny purple flowers emerge along its banks. A Black woman in a cream dress stands on the lower-right ridge looking toward the transformed distance. Light breaks through retreating clouds. Preserve bright open sky on the upper-left.
days.scriptureFull: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and* rivers in the desert.

days.title: He Carries Me Still
days.scriptureExcerpt: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
days.encouragement: When the road grew too heavy, you were not left behind. The footprints changed because love lifted you.
days.prayer: Jesus, receive the burden I can no longer disguise as strength. Carry me until my soul remembers how deeply You care. Amen.

From the lower foreground to midpoint are two separate people's realistic, small, old simple leather-sandal print trails walking closely side by side, each with a normal alternating left-right gait and narrow stride. At midpoint one person's entire trail ends abruptly; the other alternating sandal trail continues toward the horizon. No merging and no Y shape. Far, faint, and small near the horizon, a robed man carries another adult safely in both arms. Elevated wide view makes the path long and the prints a quiet detail. Preserve luminous sky on the upper-left.

days.title: He Will Finish the Work
days.scriptureExcerpt: He which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ
days.encouragement: You are not a discarded draft. The God who began this work remains patient, present, and committed to its completion.
days.prayer: Faithful God, keep shaping what is unfinished in me. Replace impatience with trust in Your steady hands. Amen.
days.affirmation: God is not finished with me.
days.scene: A beautiful artisan studio at warm morning light. Dark-skinned adult hands stitch fine gold thread through an unfinished deep-plum textile whose pattern gradually becomes a sunrise over mountains. Nearby are wooden tools, linen, spools, and a small green sprig. The maker sits on the left edge, mostly out of frame. Preserve a softly lit cream wall and uncluttered table on the right.

days.prayer: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, fill my ordinary life with Your love. Let every next step carry light to someone who needs it. Amen.
